Attempted placement ▶ From P2, we attempt to place value 7. ▶ Since 7 is already in the copied segment, this is a conflict. PMX repair rule ▶ Look up the correspondence induced by the copied segment: 7 ↔ 5, 5 ↔ 2 ▶ Replace the conflicting value by following the correspondence. ▶ Continue until a value not in the segment is found. Outcome ▶ 7 → 5 (still conflict) ▶ 5 → 2 (safe) Note Conflicts are resolved by repeatedly chasing segment correspondences.
